title: Running Commentary on Torah 38 — Merkevos Pharaoh
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 38 — מרכבות פרעה
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **Opening pasuk**: **"Merkevos Pharaoh v'cheilo yarah ba'yam"** (Shemos 15:4). 'Pharaoh's chariots and his army He cast into the sea...'

intermediate.he: **"מרכבות פרעה וחילו ירה בים"** (שמ' טו, ד).

beginner.en: **"α. Every person must **pashpish his ways** constantly: is he **davuk in Hashem**? The **siman of deveikus = tefillin** — tefillin are the siman of deveikus (Chidushei Aggados Berachos 6a on **'minayin she'HKBH maniach tefillin'**)."**

intermediate.en: **α. Pashpish deveikus constantly**; siman=**tefillin** (Ber 6a "HKBH maniach tefillin").
intermediate.he: **α. פשפוש דבקות מתמיד**; סימן=**תפילין** (בר' ו. "הקב"ה מניח תפילין").

beginner.en: **"β. Cannot reach tefillin except by **elevating + rectifying the dibbur**. **Dibbur=ru'ach piv of HKBH=malchus peh** (Pasach Eliyahu). It is bechina of **yam** — all rivers flow into it (Kohelet 1:7; Tikkun 11 of the Tikkunim Acharonim). =**Adnai** — **'Adnai sfasai tiftach'** (Tehillim 51:17). When dibbur (=Adnai) is pogem, **ru'ach piv becomes ru'ach se'arah** — because the **27 letters each comprised of 27**..."**

intermediate.en: **β. Tefillin via elevating dibbur**. Dibbur=ru'ach piv of HKBH=malchus peh (Pasach Eliyahu); =yam (Koh 1:7; Tik 11)=Adnai (Teh 51:17). Pogem dibbur → ru'ach se'arah.
intermediate.he: **ב. תפילין ע"י העלאת דיבור**. דיבור=רוח פיו של הקב"ה=מלכות פה (פתח אליהו); =ים (קה' א, ז; תיקון יא)=אדנ-י (תה' נא, יז). פגם → רוח סערה.

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. קה' א, ז; תיקון יא; תה' נא, יז.

beginner.en: **"γ. Must raise dibbur to its **shoresh = zero'a** — the **5 etzba'os of yad semol = 5 gevuros = 5 motza'os ha'peh** (5 places of articulation). **'Mi y'malel gvuros Hashem'** (Tehillim 106:2): dibbur via gevuros. **'U'gvurascha y'daberu'** (Tehillim 145:11); **'ha'lo koh d'vari ka'esh'** (Yirmiyahu 23:29)."** **"Beginning of the aliyah of dibbur is from its **rosh = the **mivchar ha'emes** within the dibbur — the 'head.'"**

intermediate.en: **γ. Raise dibbur to zero'a=5 etzba'os semol=5 gevuros=5 motza'os ha'peh** (Teh 106:2; 145:11; Yir 23:29 "d'vari ka'esh"). Start from **rosh=mivchar ha'emes**.
intermediate.he: **ג. העלאה לזרוע=ה' אצבעות שמאל=ה' גבורות=ה' מוצאות הפה** (תה' קו, ב; קמה, יא; יר' כג, כט). תחילה מ**ראש=מבחר האמת**.

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. תה' קו, ב; קמה, יא; יר' כג, כט.

beginner.en: **"δ. **Tikkun ha'dibbur** via **Torah studied in tzar/aniyus/dachakus** = **laylah** (then **shiltanusa d'keitz kol basar**: 'keitz sam la'choshech'; **'v'la'choshech kara laylah,'** Bereshis 1:5). Chazal (Chagigah 12b): **'ha'lomed Torah ba'lailah, moshchin alav chut shel chesed ba'yom'**. **Chesed=boker d'Avraham** (Zohar Miketz 203a on **'ha'boker ohr'**). **V'ha'anashim shulchu = inun marei d'dinin; heimah v'chamoreihem**..."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Tikkun dibbur via Torah ba'lailah/tzar/aniyus** (keitz sam la'choshech; Chag 12b "chut shel chesed ba'yom"). Chesed=boker d'Avraham (Zohar Miketz 203a).
intermediate.he: **ד. תיקון דיבור ע"י תורה בלילה/צר/עניות** (קץ שם לחושך; חג' יב: "חוט של חסד ביום"). חסד=בוקר דאברהם (זוה"ק מקץ רג).

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. חג' יב:; זוה"ק מקץ רג.

beginner.en: **"PEC Sha'ar ha'Tefillin perek 7 on **'Simeini k'chosam al libecha'** (Shir 8:6): via Torah ba'lailah, **k'ohr ha'boker** the **rosh ha'Malchus (=dibbur) rises** and seats in the **zro'a d'Z"A**, receiving the **reshimu in chazeh d'Z"A**. Z"A receives its reshimu. Via tefilah, **new mochin enter**, and reshimu exits as **tefillin**."**

intermediate.en: **PEC Sha'ar Tefillin 7**: Torah ba'lailah → **rosh Malchus rises** → sits in zro'a d'Z"A → reshimu in chazeh. Tefilah brings new mochin; reshimu exits as **tefillin**.
intermediate.he: **פע"ח שער תפילין ז**: תורה בלילה → **ראש מלכות עולה** → יושב בזרוע דז"א → רשימו בחזה. תפילה מביאה מוחין חדשים; רשימו יוצא כ**תפילין**.

beginner.en: **"ε. When dibbur is raised to shoresh (gevuros) and he begins to **speak beino l'bein kono b'shalhevas ha'gevuros**, arousing himself to avodas Hashem — the **shoresh of gevuros** enters = **chamimus ha'lev** (**'cham libi b'kirbi b'hagigi,'** Tehillim 39:4). There is the true shoresh of emes of dibbur — **'doveir emes bi'levavo'** (Tehillim 15:2)."**

intermediate.en: **ε. Speak beino l'bein kono b'shalhevas gevuros** → shoresh gevuros enters=**chamimus lev** (Teh 39:4 "cham libi"; Teh 15:2 "doveir emes bi'levavo").
intermediate.he: **ה. דיבור בינו לבין קונו בשלהבת הגבורות** → שורש גבורות נכנס=**חמימות הלב** (תה' לט, ד "חם ליבי"; תה' טו, ב "דובר אמת בלבבו").

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. תה' לט, ד; טו, ב.

beginner.en: **"ζ. **Moshe merited the light of tefillin**: Zohar Hashmatos Bereshis 262 on **'va'yisnatzlu es edyam'** (Shemos 33:6) = tefillin. **'U'Moshe yikach es ha'ohel'** = took those oros, lashon of **'b'hilo neiro alei roshi'** (Iyov 29:3). (See Zohar Bereshis 52b; Ki Tisa 194a.)"** **"**'Ki karan ohr panav'** (Shemos 34:29) — on account of the **keren echad b'mitzcho** (Chullin 60b) = tefillin on the forehead. Hence **'va'yiru mi'geshes elav'** — illuminated yirah on them (**'az tavin yiras Hashem,'** Mishlei 2:5)."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Moshe=ohr tefillin** (Zohar Hashmatos Ber 262 on Shem 33:6; Ber 52b; Ki Tisa 194a; "b'hilo neiro," Iyov 29:3). **Keren b'mitzcho** (Chul 60b)=tefillin; illuminates yirah (Shem 34:29; Mishlei 2:5).
intermediate.he: **ו. משה=אור תפילין** (זוה"ק השמ' בר' רסב על שמ' לג, ו; בר' נב:; תשא קצד. "בהילו נרו", איוב כט, ג). **קרן במצחו** (חול' ס:)=תפילין; מאיר יראה (שמ' לד, כט; מש' ב, ה).

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. שמ' לג, ו; זוה"ק בר' רסב; שמ' לד, כט; חול' ס:; מש' ב, ה.

beginner.en: **"η. Bechoros 57b: **'erez nafal bi'mkomeinu, v'avru alav shisha asar karnos al chido'** — known: **when the tzaddik who serves Hashem b'deveikus gedolah falls to a lower madreigah** — even though that new madreigah is still great relative to other tzaddikim, for **him** it's a **nefilah**. He is embarrassed as if he sinned; does teshuvah as if he sinned; comes thereby to **bushah gedolah=bechina of tefillin=**'az tavin yiras Hashem.'**"**

intermediate.en: **η. Bech 57b "erez nafal... 16 karnos al chido"**: tzaddik-deveikus falls to lower madreigah → bushah gedolah=tefillin.
intermediate.he: **ז. בכ' נז: "ארז נפל... ט"ז קרנות על חודו"**: צדיק־דבקות נופל → בושה גדולה=תפילין.

beginner.en: **"**Peirush**: **'Im tashiv mi'Shabbos raglecha, asos chafatzecha b'yom kodshi'** (Yeshayahu 58:13). **Shabbos=bushah**. **Raglecha** — first rectify the dibbur (called **regel**). How? **'Asos chafatzecha b'yom kodshi'** — **zuhama d'nachash** caused **39 klalos = 39 melachos**; must draw **kedushas Shabbos** into weekdays. Mekhilta: **'zachor es yom ha'Shabbos'** = **'zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbos'**. Per sanctification of weekdays so the zuhama (keitz kol basar/ru'ach se'arah) is pushed."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: **"Im tashiv mi'Shabbos raglecha"** (Yesh 58:13): Shabbos=bushah; raglecha=tikkun dibbur. **Kedushas Shabbos into chol** pushes zuhama/ru'ach se'arah. Mekhilta "zachrehu mei'echad b'Shabbos."
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: **"אם תשיב משבת רגלך"** (יש' נח, יג): שבת=בושה; רגלך=תיקון דיבור. **קדושת שבת לחול** דוחה זוהמה/רוח סערה. מכיל' "זכרהו מאחד בשבת".

beginner.en: **R"N editorial**: **"This Torah is **sod kavanos tefillin**, as marked throughout. I heard from his holy mouth that he considered many Torahs — and said: **all are sod kavanos tefillin** — Torah **'BaChatzotzros v'kol shofar'** (T5), **'Anochi Hashem Elokecha'** (T4), **'Kra es Yehoshua'** (T6), **'Mi ha'ish he'chafetz chayim'** (T33) — all from the holy mouth's kavanos tefillin..."**

intermediate.en: R"N: **Torah=sod kavanos tefillin**. Related Torahs in the kavanos-tefillin cycle: T5 ("BaChatzotzros"), T4 ("Anochi"), T6 ("Kra"), T33 ("Mi ha'ish").
intermediate.he: ר"נ: **התורה=סוד כוונות תפילין**. תורות קשורות: ת"ה ("בחצוצרות"), ת"ד ("אנוכי"), ת"ו ("קרא את יהושע"), ת"לג ("מי האיש").
